d.cg.aa.html: דרב (√ of foll. cf. Arabic become accltstomed, trained, Arabic train, cf. Fl NHWB i. 444; also Eth. Ethiopic (quadrilit.) jaculando infigere, etc.; or, since דָּרְבָן Aram. in form, & I S 13:21 perh. secondary, possibly regard as Aram. loan-word & connect with Ar. Arabic be sharp, penetrating (GFM, note of Apr. 1892)).

d.cg.ab.html: דָּרבָן n.[m.] goad, 1 S 13:21

d.cg.ac.html: [דָּֽרְבֹנָה] n.[f.] goad, only abs. pl. Ec 12:11

d.ch.aa.html: דרג (√ of foll. cf. Ar. Arabic go on foot, step by step, walk, Arabic rise in grade, rank; NH דרג Hiph. raise, make high; Eth. Ethiopic is be connected; Aram. Syriac (verb denom. acc. to PS); also As. darâgu, be high, lift, Lyon Sargontexte 80, durgu, daragu, path, way (of steep mountain paths) COTGloss (cf. also דרך) ; Ar. Arabic; a step, stair, Aram. דַּרְגָּא, Syriac, Syriac, id.)

d.ch.ac.html: דַּרְדַּע n.pr.m. only 1 K 5:11 Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol = דָ֖רַע 1 Ch 2:6

d.ch.af.html:
דָּֽרְיָ֫וֶשׁ n.pr.m. Darius
1 Darius Hystaspis, 522-485
2 Darius Codomannus, 336-332
3 ‘Darius the Mede,’

d.ci.aa.html:
דָּרַךְ vb. tread, march
Qal
1 tread, march, march forth
2 tread upon
3 tread wine- (or oil-) press
4 tread (i.e. bend) the bow
Hiph.
1 tread, tread down
2 tread (bend) the bow
3 causat. cause to tread or march, lead

d.ci.ab.html:
דֶּ֫רֶךְ 715 n.m. way, road, distance, journey, manner
1 way, road, path
2 journey
3 of direction, almost or quite = toward
4 way, manner
5 fig. of course of life, or action, undertakings
6
a of moral action and character
b of duty
c specif.: in good sense
d oftener in bad sense
e way of י׳

d.ci.ac.html: [מִדְרָךְ] n.[m.] treading- or stepping-place, place for the foot to tread on, only Dt 2:5

d.ci.ad.html: [דַּרְכְּמוֹן, אֲדַרְכּוֹן] n.[m.] unit (appar. of weight, certainly) of value, rare & late, perh. drachma, others daric

d.cj.aa.html: דרע (acc. to Thes connected with Aram. דְּרָע, אֶדְרָע arm, Heb. זְרֹועַ, whence foll. in sense strong, of fortified city ; this, however, is dub.)

d.cj.ab.html: אֶדְרֶ֫עִי n.pr.loc. a chief city of Bashan

d.ck.ab.html: דַּרְקוֹן n.pr.m. head of family of Nethinim, who went up with Zerubbabel

d.cl.aa.html:
דרר (√ of foll. words: Ar. Arabic;—
1 stream, flow abundantly (of milk, tears, rain, etc.), cf. I. דְּרֹור.
2 be abundant, luxuriant (of herbage), cf. Arabic a kind of tree, now elm (Lane), & דַּרְדַּר.
3 run vehemently, easily (of horse), cf. Arabic swift horse, or other beast, & II. דְּרֹור.
4 give light, shine (of lamp), cf. Arabic shining star, Arabic glistening or shining of sword, Arabic pearls (coll.) & דַּר; hence prob. דָּרֹום).

d.cl.ab.html: דַּר n.[m.] pearl? mother of pearl? (Ar. Arabic pearls, Arabic a pearl) Est 1:6.

d.cl.ac.html:
דְּרוֹר n.[m.] a flowing; free run, liberty;—
1 myrrh of flowing, fine-flowing m.
2 proclaim liberty

d.cm.aa.html:
דָּרַשׁ 162 vb. resort to, seek
Qal
1 (tread a place,) resort to, frequent
2 seek, consult, inquire of
3 seek deity in prayer and worship
4
a seek, with idea of demanding, require
b inquire, investigate (a matter)
5 ask for, require, demand
6 seek with application, study, follow, practise
7 seek with care, care for
Niph.
1 let oneself be inquired of, consulted, only of God
2 be sought out
3 be required, of blood

d.cn.aa.html:
[דָּשָׁא] vb. sprout, shoot, grow green
Qal Jo 2:22
Hiph. Gn 1:11 cause to sprout or shoot forth

d.co.aa.html:
דָּשֵׁן vb. be fat, grow fat
Qal fig. of Isr.’s prosperity
Pi. causat. make fat i.e. anoint, symbol of festivity and joy; of bodily effect of good news; find a burnt-offering fat = acceptable; elsewhere denom.;—take away, clear away the fat ashes (acc. of altar cleared)
Pu. pass. of causat. Pi. be made fat, of dust saturated
Hothp. of Yahweh’s sword:—it hath fattened itself

d.co.ab.html:
דֶּ֫שֶׁן n.m. fatness, fat ashes
1 fatness, abundance, luxuriance, oil
2 fat ashes; i.e. ashes of victims, mixed with fat

d.co.ad.html:
דָּת n.f. decree, law, usage, only in Persian period
1 decree, edict, commission of Pers. king
2 law, permanently valid and applicable

d.co.ae.html: דָּתָן n.pr.m. a Reubenite, son of Eliab

d.co.af.html: דֹּתָן n.pr.loc. in N. Israel, north of Samaria
